appamocana.p: [Na+pamocana] (na) CL=9 not giving up. It is not a giving up.

DOP: pamocana n. and mfn. [ S. pramocana], 1. ( n. ) loosening, untying; setting free, deliverance; S I 62, 24* (na ca appatvā lokantaṃ dukkhā atthi ~aṃ); 172, 34* (saddhā bījaṃ … saccaṃ karomi niddānaṃ soraccaṃ me ~aṃ; Spk I 254, 20 : ~an ti yogavissajjanaṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee yogga-) = Sn 78; A II 37, 16* (yo vedī sabbasattānaṃ maccupāsā ~aṃ); Sn 1064 (nāhaṃ sahissāmi ~āya kathaṃkathiṃ Dhotaka kañci loke, Be so; Ce, Ee gamissāmi; Se samissāmi; quoted Nidd II [ Be ] 94, 14* : Be, Ce so; Ee samīhāmi; Se samissāmi; 94, 18 foll.: nāhaṃ taṃ sakkomi muñcituṃ … atha vā na īhāmi na samīhāmi na ussahāmi …; Pj II 592, 26 foll.: ahaṃ na sahissāmi na sakkhissāmi, na vāyamissāmī ti vuttaṃ hoti, Be, Se so; Ce na gamissāmi na sikkhissāmi …; Ee na gamissāmi na sikkhāmi …) quoted Kv 194, 17* ( Be so; Ce, Ee, Se gamissāmi); Sv 1054, 38 (sabbaganthānaṃ ~aṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee mocanaṃ); It-a II 151, 11 (~assa nimittabhūtaṃ nibbānaṃ); — 2. ( mfn. ) loosening; setting free (from); — ifc see sabbagantha-; — appamocana , n. , not untying; not truly setting free; Spk I 254, 23 (puna pi sāyaṇhe … yojetabbato ~am eva hoti) = Pj II 149, 7 .
CPD: a-ppamocana , n. [ 3 a + sa. pramocana], no ( final ) release; Pj ll 149, 1 .
